overview_description.description: Morphle Labs develops robotic and automated systems for cancer diagnostics, combining robotics, optics, and artificial intelligence to streamline pathology workflows. Its signature products include RoboTome, a robotic microtome that slices tissue biopsy blocks faster than manual methods, and MorphoLens, a high-throughput slide scanner that captures digital pathology images efficiently. The company also offers the Hemolens platform for scanning blood smears using AI to detect and sort cells. These systems integrate with laboratory information systems, support telepathology, and aim to reduce manual workload, improve throughput, and standardize diagnostics.

about_short_description.short_description: Morphle Labs is a deep-tech healthcare automation company that develops robotic and imaging systems for cancer diagnostics.

product.name: Robotome
product.description: A robotic microtome automating tissue sectioning with high throughput and consistent 4µm sections, supporting various block types and slide traceability.

product.name: MorphoLens 240
product.description: A high-volume tissue slide scanner capable of scanning up to 240 slides with integrated workflows and image storage for histopathology, IHC, and cytopathology.

product.name: MorphoLens 6
product.description: A slide scanner optimized for scanning up to 100 slides per day, suitable for medium-volume labs with integrated workflows and image storage.

product.name: MorphoLens 1
product.description: A compact tissue and cytology slide scanner with a small footprint, designed for research projects and low-volume scanning.

product.name: HemoLens 1
product.description: A slide scanner specialized for hematology applications such as peripheral blood smears, bone marrow aspirates, and other cytology requiring 100x magnification.

product.name: RoboReq
product.description: An AI-powered optical character recognition system automating requisition data entry and grossing notes capture in pathology workflows.
